# Topic Desk Studio v0.4.4 — English

This update improves settings layout and regional source controls.

- Improve settings-page centering and prevent content from stretching beyond its container when resizing the window.
- Place source counts above a flat action toolbar, remove redundant labels, and allow actions to wrap on smaller windows.
- Toggle domestic and international sources off or on in one click. Regions with any enabled sources close first; fully disabled regions reopen together.
- Use distinct location and globe icons, highlight enabled regions, and show the next action in tooltips.
- Place Restore default sources after the international-source control.
- Hide Open data directory, the storage path, and Create backup outside development mode.

---

# Topic Desk Studio v0.4.4 — 中文

本次更新优化设置页面布局及数据源批量开关。

- 改善窗口尺寸变化时设置页面的居中表现，避免内容撑出容器。
- 数据源数量概览置于操作栏上方，操作按钮平铺，删除冗余文案，窄窗口自动换行。
- 国内、国际数据源支持一键关闭与打开；部分启用时先全部关闭，全部关闭后再次点击全部打开。
- 国内与国际使用不同图标，启用时高亮，悬停提示下一步操作。
- “恢复默认来源”调整至“国际数据源”按钮之后。
- 非开发模式隐藏“打开数据目录”、存储地址和“创建备份”。
